valor: Carlos is approaching middle age, trapped in a personal crisis that has gone on too long. Rosa, his mother, suffers disabling pain that only the warm waters of hydrotherapy ease. One night, she offers to make the ultimate sacrifice so that they can both move on to a better place. About love, hope and relief.
